name: tool_inspired
description: Tool aesthetic, calibrated against the actual Aenima 2019 remaster (Forty Six & 2). Darker than typical modern rock, controlled sub and low, scooped lower-mids, preserved 2-5 kHz presence, very controlled high-air. Pushed-but-streaming-friendly LUFS target.
sources: Measured spectrum of Tool — Forty Six & 2 (Aenima 2019 Remaster, FLAC)
Original master sits at ~-9.6 LUFS / LRA 9 LU / crest 12 dB — heavy production
Profile targets calibrated to -14 LUFS reference (streaming-friendly Tool character) — measured Aenima values shifted +1 dB from -15 LUFS measurement
calibration_note: Tonal balance targets are wideband band-RMS measured on the 2019 Aenima remaster at -15 LUFS, then shifted +1 dB to align with the profile's -14 LUFS streaming target. Profile v1.0 was based on an incorrect 'Tool = heavy sub + scooped mids' assumption; v2.0 reflects the actual spectrum reveal that Tool 2019 remaster is darker overall, with controlled sub.
